memory.scope: Cold synchronous decode; each sample uses a new process and WASM instance. Historical parser uses current dependencies.
memory.accounting: Stage snapshots, not JS heap peaks. WASM capacity is linear-memory capacity, not live allocations. ArrayBuffers is included in external; fields must not be summed. GC runs before decode, after retaining outputs, and after release; none is forced during decode. Covariance probes affect execution; no timing or GPU claims.

unprofiledTiming.scope: Synchronous PLY decode including output allocation and WASM covariance; excludes I/O, WASM init, view preparation and GPU. Shared warmed WASM instance; not a memory benchmark
